invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so result should not be null on normal completion.
clusteringInstantTime is passed through to another call and must be valid, so it should not be null.
context is provided to the constructor of JavaExecuteClusteringCommitActionExecutor and hence must not be null.
result is expected to return a List of WriteStatus objects.
The method contract suggests that a valid result will contain a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
